background.note: border ring is not a flat fill (largest color covers 45% of it, needs 75%); no background pixels were excluded, so candidate distances may be skewed by the background

play.action: four-frame one-shot breath, immediately readable over #10131c. In every 1536x960 slot draw one connected open-bottom rectangular Pi-shaped border: a straight horizontal top bar from x=80 to x=1456 and straight vertical side bars at x=80 and x=1456 down to y=700. It must hug the slot edges and fill almost the whole width; it is not a compact arch, oval, doorway, or centered icon. Use a fully opaque pale-cyan-white core 32, 48, 64, then 40 pixels thick across frames 1-4. No hairlines, haze, tiny corner marks, or translucent-only border. Keep the broad center and bottom opening empty.

style: quiet but unmistakable high-contrast abstract game effect matching the accepted base image; a thick fully opaque pale-cyan-white core with crisp clean edges and only a restrained soft fringe, no pixel art, no dark outline, no palette reduction
